options.name: dependencies
options.description: list of triggers that this trigger is dependent on

options.name: desc
options.description: Additional description of the trigger. Overrides "comments" in API docs.

options.name: host_name
options.description: Name of host to add trigger to. Required when I(template_name) is not used. Mutually exclusive with I(template_name).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of trigger to create or delete. Overrides "description" in API docs. Cannot be changed. If a trigger's name needs to be changed, it needs to deleted and recreated

options.name: params
options.description: Parameters to create/update trigger with. Required if state is "present". Parameters as defined at https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/current/en/manual/api/reference/trigger/object Additionally supported parameters are below.

options.name: template_name
options.description: Name of template to add trigger to. Required when I(host_name) is not used. Mutually exclusive with I(host_name).
